tha-ap403:1.1: XLI. [398. Tissametteyya.] Pabbhārakuṭaṃ nissāya Sobhito nāma tāpaso / pavattaphalaṃ bhuñjitvā vasati pabbatantare. // //
tha-ap403:2.1: Aggidārum āharitvā ujjālesim ahaṃ tadā / uttamatthaṃ gavesanto brahmalokupattiyā. // //
tha-ap403:3.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / mam uddharitukāmo so āgacchi mama santike. // //
tha-ap403:4.1: Kiṃ karohi mahāpuññaṃ dehi me aggidārukaṃ / aham aggiṃ paricare tato me suddhi hehiti. // //
tha-ap403:5.1: Subhaddako tvaṃ manuja deva te tvaṃ pajānasi / tuvam aggim paricara handa te aggidārukaṃ. // //
tha-ap403:6.1: Tato kaṭṭhaṃ gahetvāna aggim ujjālayī jino / na tattha kaṭṭhaṃ pajjhāyi: pāṭihīraṃ mahesino. // //
tha-ap403:7.1: Na te aggi pajjalati āhutī te na vijjati / niratthakaṃ vataṃ tuyham aggiṃ paricarassu me. // //
tha-ap403:8.1: Kīdiso so mahāvīra aggi tava pavuccati / mayham pi kathayass' etam ubho paricarāmase. // //
tha-ap403:9.1: Hetudhammanirodhāya kilesājhāpanāya ca / issāmacchariyaṃ hitvā: tayo ete mam' āhutī. // //
tha-ap403:10.1: Kīdiso tvaṃ mahāvīra katham gotto 'si mārisa / ācārapaṭipatti te bāḷham kho mama ruccati. // //
tha-ap403:11.1: Khattiyamhi kūle jāto abhiññāpāramiṅgato / sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo n' atthi dāni punabbhavo. // //
tha-ap403:12.1: Yadi Buddho 'si sabbaññū pabhaṅkara tamonuda / namassissāmi taṃ deva dukkhass' antakaro tuvaṃ. // //
tha-ap403:13.1: Pattharitvājinañ cammaṃ nisīdanam adās' ahaṃ / nisīda tattha sabbaññū upaṭṭhissām' ahaṃ tavaṃ. // //
tha-ap403:14.1: Nisīdi bhagavā tattha ajinamhi suvitthate / nimantayitvā sambuddhaṃ pabbatam agamās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap403:15.1: Khāribhārañ ca pūretvā tindukaṃ phalam āhariṃ / madhunā yojayitvāna phalaṃ Buddhass' adās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap403:16.1: Mama nijjhāyamānassa paribhuñji tadā jino / tattha cittaṃ pasādesiṃ pekkhanto lokanāyakaṃ. // //
tha-ap403:17.1: Padumuttaro lokavidū āhutīnaṃ paṭiggaho / mam' assame nisīditvā imā gāthā abhāsatha: // //
tha-ap403:18.1: ‘Yo me phalena tappesi pasanno sehi pāṇihi / tam ahaṃ kittayissāmi; suṇotha mama bhāsato: // //
tha-ap403:19.1: Pañcavīsatikkhattuṃ so devarajjaṃ karissati / sahassakkhattuṃ rājā ca cakkavattī bhavissati. // //
tha-ap403:20.1: Tassa saṅkappam aññāya pubbakammasamaṅgino / annaṃ pānañ ca vatthañ ca sayanañ ca mahārahaṃ // //
tha-ap403:21.1: Puññakammena saṃyuttā nibbattissanti tāvade / sadā pamudito cāyaṃ bhavissati anāmayo. // //
tha-ap403:22.1: Upapajjati yaṃ yoniṃ devattam atha mānusaṃ / sabbattha sukhito hutvā manussattaṃ bhavissati. // //
tha-ap403:23.1: Ajjhāyako mantadharo tiṇṇavedāna pāragū / sambuddham upagantvāna arahā so bhavissati.' // //
tha-ap403:24.1: Yato sarāmi attānaṃ yato patto 'smi viññutaṃ / bhoge me ūnatā n' atthi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap403:25.1: Varadhammam anuppatto rāgadose samūhaniṃ / sabbāsavaparikkhīṇo n' atthi dāni punabbhavo.
tha-ap403:29.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Tissametteyyo thero i. g. a-ti.
